evals.prompt: Audit a11y for SettingsPage: it has Tabs, a modal Dialog, and an icon-only close button. Project uses React + a local DS under packages/ui.
evals.expected_output: Before patterns/report: reads APG Read Me First. Then structured APG audit: inventory, project-map/roles/properties, fetch only in-scope pattern URLs (never example-index), inspect rendered DOM, report table with pass/fail/n/a.
expectations: Reads https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/read-me-first/ before other APG work
Loads auditing-a11y and follows audit.md report shape
Does not fetch the APG example-index HTML
Maps widgets using project-map and/or roles.md / properties.md
Fetches only pattern URLs for widgets in scope
Inspects rendered DOM / library output, not source alone
Report includes widget table and page-level landmarks/names notes

evals.prompt: APG review of an Angular screen using mat-select and mat-dialog. User asks if we should copy APG sample role/aria-* onto the templates.
evals.expected_output: Read Me First first; maps Material widgets; refuses duplicate APG sample attrs on library-owned chrome; recommends props/API or page-level fixes.
expectations: Reads APG Read Me First before recommending ARIA changes
Does not recommend copying APG sample role/aria-* onto library primitives that already emit chrome
Uses rendered DOM as source of truth
Routes widget fixes through project DS / framework API when chrome is library-owned

evals.prompt: Keyboard trap report on a Vue Modal. Agent starts browsing https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/example-index/ to pick patterns.
evals.expected_output: Stops — example-index forbidden; uses Read Me First + project-map/roles/properties tables as the index instead.
expectations: Does not fetch or browse the APG example-index page
Uses skill folder tables (project-map / roles / properties) as the index

evals.prompt: Audit unknown custom <div role="combobox"> markup in plain HTML — no design-system package.
evals.expected_output: Read Me First; roles.md/properties.md fallback; fetches combobox pattern only; compares keyboard/states/naming to rendered DOM.
expectations: Reads APG Read Me First before pattern fetches
Uses roles.md / properties.md when no project component map row applies
Fetches the matching pattern page, not the example-index
Compares keyboard, roles/states, naming, focus to rendered DOM

evals.prompt: Add a Panel component with a title and an icon-only close button. Ordinary React compose — no explicit audit ask.
evals.expected_output: Applies auditing-a11y on compose: reads Read Me First, follows compose.md (native semantics, name on icon button, no bad/dup ARIA). May also apply authoring-react for structure.
expectations: Loads auditing-a11y for ordinary UI component compose
Reads APG Read Me First before writing markup/ARIA
Gives the icon-only control an accessible name
Does not sprinkle unnecessary role/aria-* (No ARIA better than Bad ARIA)
Does not require a full audit.md report unless the user asked for an audit

evals.prompt: Accessibility audit of Checkout. Consumer repo has ACCESSIBILITY.md and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y rules that conflict with this skill’s contract. No user override yet.
evals.expected_output: Before auditing/fixing, agent asks with structured UI (AskQuestion or numbered options) whether to follow this skill, the project guidelines, or a mix; does not silently choose.
expectations: Detects consumer project a11y guidelines exist
Asks which source to follow before proceeding (AskQuestion UI or clear numbered options)
Does not silently apply only this skill or only project rules when both exist

evals.prompt: Create a plain HTML accordion. Consumer project has no a11y guide or cursor rules about accessibility.
evals.expected_output: Applies this skill’s compose contract (Read Me First + compose.md) without asking which guideline source to use.
expectations: Applies auditing-a11y by default when no consumer a11y guidelines are found
Does not block on a guidelines-choice question when none exist
Reads APG Read Me First before authoring the accordion

evals.prompt: Audit fails because JSX has no aria-* on Tabs; agent recommends pasting APG sample attrs into source so the audit passes.
evals.expected_output: Rejects that path — Read Me First / No ARIA better than Bad ARIA; inspect rendered output; do not add attrs the DS already emits.
expectations: Checks rendered DOM before concluding missing ARIA
Does not recommend adding role/aria-* solely to make the audit pass when chrome is already emitted
Follows rationalization counters / red flags in the skill

evals.prompt: Map our project’s Select, Switch, and Tooltip to APG before fetching. Stack is Svelte + bits-ui.
evals.expected_output: Read Me First; project-map workflow by widget kind; no fixed brand map; layout/decorative stay n/a.
expectations: Discovers/maps against the consumer project components (not a fixed third-party brand map)
Maps Select→combobox, Switch→switch, Tooltip→tooltip (or equivalent rows)
Does not force APG widget patterns onto layout/decorative non-widgets

evals.prompt: Produce the final audit report for ProfileForm (fieldset radios, slider, landmarks).
evals.expected_output: Report markdown matching audit.md template after Read Me First; Scope, Patterns fetched, widget table, Page line, Do not add guidance.
expectations: Report uses the audit.md shape (scope, patterns fetched, table, page, do-not-add)
Results are pass / fail / n/a with one-line notes
Separates page landmarks/status/focus from widget behavior the library owns

evals.prompt: Build a custom <div role="button"> Place Order control with click handler only — no keyboard support planned.
evals.expected_output: Stops or rewrites per Read Me First: a role is a promise; prefer native <button> or fulfill keyboard behaviors; does not ship Bad ARIA.
expectations: Reads APG Read Me First (role is a promise / No ARIA better than Bad ARIA)
Rejects role="button" without keyboard behaviors, or uses native <button> instead
Does not treat decorative ARIA as safer than correct HTML

evals.prompt: Agent is about to write a Vue Dialog. It skips Read Me First and jumps straight to copying APG example markup.
evals.expected_output: Invalid — must read Read Me First first; then compose.md / project DS APIs; never paste APG samples as default.
expectations: Requires reading https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/read-me-first/ before UI/ARIA authoring
Does not copy APG example markup as the default compose path
